units.RK-10.1-073: That no room-state write follows the commit's transaction is the shape of the store's writes: a scenario sees the timeline and the counters agree after every call, which RK-10.1-070 and RK-10.1-071 cover, never a write made apart from the commit.
units.RK-10.2-007: BroadcastResult is what the pipeline's own broadcast() returns: no public call hands it out, so a scenario reads its members only through the units that produce them (deliveries, reentry events, tasks, observations, per-channel errors).
